name: Roost · Stays
description: A single-file H5 travel-booking app: 13 screens, 11 illustrated stays across 7 browsable categories, full-text search over names, cities, hosts, tags and amenities, a real date-range calendar, distance-from-me on every listing, a guest-review system with per-category scores and helpful votes, guest/pet limits, add-ons, promo codes, saved cards and trip management. Every picture is an inline SVG scene, so the environment needs no image files, no network and no emoji font.

finish.answer: final answer for question tasks; optional for action tasks

observation.text: engine.a11y(state) — an accessibility tree with #test-ids. Illustrations appear as alt-text lines, so a text-only agent still knows what each picture shows.
observation.pixels: 390x844 screenshot (browser backend); __ENV__.bounds() maps every test-id to a pixel box
observation.state: engine.snapshot(state) — canonical state plus a derived view. For the verifier only; never feed it to the agent.

world.currency: USD by default; EUR is a display-only conversion at 0.92
world.pricing: total = nightly x nights + cleaning + round(12% service) + add-ons - promo
world.user_location: Denver, Colorado — every stay carries a mocked distanceMi from here
world.units: miles by default; the Settings screen switches the display to kilometres (x1.609)
world.reviews: 26 guest reviews across the 6 stays, each with an author, month, star rating, text, optional host reply and a helpful counter the agent can vote on
world.categories: 7 categories driven by per-stay tags (not by `type`), so every category returns 3-4 stays
world.search: all whitespace-separated terms must match; the haystack is name + city + type + host + blurb + tags + amenity labels + 'free cancellation' / 'instant book'
